title: Surreal Cosmic Bridge
description: A two-headed humanoid figure with a backpack and staff walks across a wooden bridge over dark water where a large eye emerges from the ripples. Above, a massive tentacled creature with multiple eyes and a long tongue floats near ancient stone ruins adorned with runes, set against a starry sky with geometric mountains, planets, and purple flowers.
prompt: Detailed surreal black and white ink illustration with selective color accents, a two-headed humanoid explorer with backpack and staff walking on a wooden bridge over dark water with a giant eyeball emerging from the ripples, above floats a massive Lovecraftian tentacled multi-eyed creature with long tongue, ancient stone ruins with runes and archway, purple flowers growing on the rocks, geometric mountains and starry cosmos with red planets in the background, intricate linework, mysterious and symbolic atmosphere
